title: Feedback:Game updates/20260130
wikitext:
== Update, January 30, 2026 ==

First hotfix build:
* [[Melandru's Accord]] characters can no longer pick up items that were originally [[assign]]ed to other players (either because an assignment expired or the other player left the party).
* Melandru's Accord characters can no longer select account-based [[title]]s to display or receive corresponding buffs.
* Melandru's Accord characters no longer receive passive bonuses from account-based titles [[Wisdom]], [[Lucky]], and [[Treasure Hunter]].
* Melandru's Accord character progress towards [[Kind of a Big Deal|GWAMM]] no longer includes any account-based titles.

Second hotfix build:
* Fixed a bug introduced by the additional server check on [[Currency|gold]] movement: [[PvP-only character|PvP characters]] were accidentally blocked from accessing gold in [[Xunlai Chest]]s.
